title: Rule screen result (POST /screen)
description: Request: {session_id, text, lang?, partial?}. slow = exactly one soft rule; judge = two or more soft rules, or any final screen after a refusal in the same session; refuse = a hard rule in a request to buy; scam_check = a hard rule inside a story about someone else (Ruth reporting a call, text or pop-up): the station calls POST /scam-check and speaks its say, and the refusal here is the fallback if that fails. Only refuse and scam_check carry a refusal.

term.description: the words as said that matched (original text, not the folded form)

decision_id.description: set on final screens: the stored decision Priyank's Why? explains
